name: 00_титр_общий_план
prompt: Aerial drone shot slowly descending toward a modern logistics warehouse in Khorgos; a Chinese stake truck approaches the west loading dock; mountains on the horizon. Smooth forward drone move, realistic daylight.

name: 01_заезд_Л2
prompt: A Chinese stake truck with green lattice sides drives slowly along the yard toward the warehouse loading gate, dust behind the wheels, mountains in the background. Static camera with slight pan following the truck.

name: 02_конвейер_выдвигается
prompt: Inside the truck bed: the orange telescopic conveyor extends from the left, its tip with the yellow operator platform sliding smoothly into the bed next to the stacked cartons while the worker watches. Camera static, only the conveyor moves.

name: 03_выгрузка_лентой
prompt: Workers in orange vests place brown cartons onto the moving black conveyor belt; the cartons ride along the orange conveyor toward the camera. Belt motion steady, camera static.

name: 04_образец_на_DWS
prompt: A worker sets a carton on the dimension-weight-scan station; red scanner laser lines sweep over the box; the monitor updates. Slow push-in.

name: 05_сборка_стойки
prompt: Two workers stack brown cartons into a steel post pallet next to the conveyor end, heavy boxes below, light boxes on top. Natural hand movement, camera static.

name: 06_FIFO_второй_ярус_A6
prompt: A dark-grey electric forklift carries a loaded steel post pallet along the warehouse aisle toward the camera, amber beacon turning. Camera tracks slowly alongside.

name: 07_автопоезд_через_П2
prompt: A white road train with grey curtain sides drives slowly into the warehouse hall through the tall gate and stops; workers walk toward it. Camera static, truck moves.

name: 08_отбор_A14
prompt: The forklift lifts the upper steel post pallet with cartons out of the floor cell and backs away with it. Camera static, slow motion of the mast.

name: 09_стойка_в_проём
prompt: The forklift holds a loaded post pallet at the side opening of the truck body; two loaders inside take cartons one by one and set them on the truck floor. Camera static.

name: 10_пустая_стойка_к_приёмке
prompt: The forklift drives away along the aisle carrying an empty steel post pallet; workers continue loading in the background. Camera static.

name: 11_прицеп_через_проём
prompt: The forklift driver holds the post pallet level with the trailer floor while loaders inside the trailer take cartons. Camera static, subtle motion.

name: 12_пустые_стойки_у_Л2
prompt: The forklift lowers an empty steel post pallet onto another empty one, the posts seating into the cups, then backs away. Camera static.

name: 13_фото_шторы_пломба
prompt: Two workers slide the grey curtain of the truck body closed along its rail; a storekeeper photographs the body with a phone. Camera static.

name: 14_выезд_через_П2
prompt: The white road train reverses slowly in a straight line out of the warehouse through the gate into daylight. Camera static inside the hall.

name: 15_финал
prompt: Aerial drone shot rising and pulling back from the warehouse roof with skylights, logistics park and mountains in late afternoon light.
